description: Ministry of Prison Reforms - Amending Col. Ex. No. 1679/40 of 10.11.2010 the Judicial District of Rathnapura shall Comprise the Judicial Districts of Rathnapura and Kalawana
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves legal/regulatory matters as it contains an order under the Judicature Act amending judicial district boundaries and jurisdictions. It exercises powers vested by legislation and modifies the legal framework governing judicial administration, fitting the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) which include statutory instruments, legal amendments, and regulatory modifications. While it mentions a minister's name, it does not focus on government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities, and the core content is legal/administrative rather than governmental structure or personnel matters.
